name: Five-node example
test:
nodes = [ListNode(v) for v in [8, 6, 4, 2, 0]]
for left, right in zip(nodes, nodes[1:]):
    left.next = right
head = oddEvenList(nodes[0])
values = []
while head:
    values.append(head.val)
    head = head.next
assert values == [8, 4, 0, 6, 2]
